verdict: Paid ads are not live yet; organic activity is holding but slowing.
narrative: This period, all activity came through your Google Business Profile and organic Instagram — no paid ads ran, meaning zero paid leads and zero ad spend across the full 28 days. Five launch milestones originally scheduled for July 31 and August 1 are still outstanding, and getting those across the finish line is the immediate priority. GBP engagement dropped 63% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7, a confirmed fade we're watching closely as paid channels come online. Instagram reach also declined 36% week-over-week, consistent with lower organic distribution when paid support is absent. Once ads launch, paid traffic will underpin both metrics and create the lead flow your engagement was designed to deliver.
